title: Alphabet cutter set
text: Alphabet cutter set. I purchased this for a specific project (bridal shower - wanted initials) and this set has everything you'll need to spell anything - but - take a photo to get the puzzle back together in the tin!  Yikes.  The other set is rubber/silicone tipped on one side and shape of the cut side.  49 pieces in all.  Plus a cleaning brush.  I am not sure how often I will use it, but it's a really great set.  The cutters are what I would consider medium weight metal - not super thin, not super heavy - seems and looks a good quality.
